Requirement text: The mission shall deliver three independent 2.00 kg probes to the Martian surface.  (Established)
Simulation scope: A propagates three 2 kg probes to zero altitude.
Remaining FREYA verification: Independent hardware delivery, impact survival and operational science return remain untested.

Requirement text: The mission shall deliver two independent aeroshell vehicles, each carrying seven 2.00 kg probes.  (Established)
Simulation scope: One B vehicle propagates seven 2 kg probes; mission count is two by configuration.
Remaining FREYA verification: A coupled two-vehicle delivery and all fourteen hardware probes are not demonstrated.

Requirement text: Each vehicle shall remain mechanically and electrically compatible with the approved host upper-stage separation interface.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: No interface mechanical/electrical simulation.
Remaining FREYA verification: Approved host ICD, separation loads, connectors and integration acceptance are required.

Requirement text: Each vehicle shall execute a defined separation, orbit determination, deorbit, entry, descent and probe-release sequence.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Nominal separation, main burn, entry, release and descent execute numerically.
Remaining FREYA verification: Orbit state is supplied, not estimated from sensors; integrated autonomous flight software remains unverified.

Requirement text: The mission shall document allowable launch, cruise, orbit and atmospheric entry environments before design freeze.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Only assumed environments are implemented.
Remaining FREYA verification: FREYA-approved launch/cruise/entry environment specifications and worst cases remain open.

Requirement text: The mission shall define target landing regions, delivery dispersion and science-site acceptance criteria.  (Proposed assumption; verify by analysis and test) Planning baseline: Assume an initial 100 km-radius target region for A and 50 km-radius for each B vehicle, with 95% of Monte Carlo landings within the respective region; exclude scientifically prohibited terrain.
Simulation scope: Nominal target misses are inside the assumed regions.
Remaining FREYA verification: No 95% Monte Carlo dispersion demonstration or science/prohibited-terrain screening.

Requirement text: The program shall maintain independent mass, power, volume, thermal and delta-v budgets with margins approved at PDR.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Mass, gas, propulsion, thermal and power screens are available.
Remaining FREYA verification: Measured component mass/volume closure and PDR-approved margins are absent.

Requirement text: The flight system shall implement autonomous safe-state and abort/inhibit logic for premature motor ignition and pyrotechnic deployment.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Scripted event order does not implement a fault-tolerant inhibit.
Remaining FREYA verification: Independent ignition/pyro inhibits, safe states and fault-injection tests are required.

Requirement text: The nominal aeroshell outer diameter shall be 800 mm.  (Established)
Simulation scope: 0.800 m is an initialized input, not independent verification.
Remaining FREYA verification: Dimensioned drawing and manufactured diameter inspection are required.

Requirement text: The assembled aeroshell height shall be 600 mm, subject to confirmation of datum and inclusion of the upper cover.  (Established / clarify)
Simulation scope: 0.600 m is a stored geometry input.
Remaining FREYA verification: Assembly datum, cover inclusion, drawing and physical inspection remain open.

Requirement text: The lower heat shield shall retain the current baseline contour and include a nominal 70 mm radius transition to the upper-shell profile.  (Established / drawing needed)
Simulation scope: A shoulder thermal radius is assumed; no baseline-contour CAD verification.
Remaining FREYA verification: Verify the complete 70 mm transition contour on a controlled drawing and hardware.

Requirement text: The upper shell shall use aluminum alloy; grade, thickness, insulation and joint design shall be selected by structural and aerothermal analysis.  (Established / derived)
Simulation scope: No alloy, thickness, joints or structural/thermal stress model is implemented.
Remaining FREYA verification: Select alloy and demonstrate positive margins and aluminum temperature limits.

Requirement text: The lower heat shield shall use a qualified ablative thermal-protection system, with material and thickness verified for the orbital-entry trajectory.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Center/shoulder surface temperatures are calculated with generic nonablating properties.
Remaining FREYA verification: FREYA ablative material/thickness qualification is absent; heritage TPS cannot be inherited without a new environment match.

Requirement text: The carrier and all stowed probes shall fit within the aeroshell with verified deployment clearance and launch-load restraint.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Schematic stowage is not a fit or restraint test.
Remaining FREYA verification: 3-D tolerance, swept-volume clearance and launch-load restraint tests are required.

Requirement text: The upper cover opening shall provide unobstructed passage of the loaded probe carrier during ejection.  (Established)
Simulation scope: Cover movement is an illustration only.
Remaining FREYA verification: Demonstrate loaded-carrier passage through the actual opening with tolerance margins.

Requirement text: The aeroshell shall withstand launch, separation, deorbit, entry and deployment load cases with documented positive structural margins.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Nominal entry dynamic pressure and deceleration are calculated.
Remaining FREYA verification: No load-to-strength FEA, launch/separation vibration qualification or positive structural margins.

Requirement text: All attachments across the heat shield shall preserve TPS integrity; sacrificial external DOM connections shall not require through-holes in the heat shield.  (Established / derived)
Simulation scope: Module placement is schematic.
Remaining FREYA verification: TPS continuity drawings, attachment design and representative heating/separation inspection remain open.

Requirement text: The deorbit module shall use one J-class solid rocket motor in the baseline configuration.  (Established)
Simulation scope: A assumes a 100 N, 1280 N s reference motor; no selected J-class flight unit.
Remaining FREYA verification: Motor identification, thrust-curve characterization and space-environment qualification remain open.

Requirement text: The vehicle shall provide four reaction wheels for attitude control, with wheel-axis geometry and independent controllability verified.  (Established / verify)
Simulation scope: Reaction-wheel hardware/control is not simulated.
Remaining FREYA verification: Verify FREYA four-wheel mounting, controllability, saturation and desaturation; proposed cold-gas architecture is a separate trade.

Requirement text: The attitude solution shall fuse inertial MEMS gyro measurements with camera-derived Mars limb or feature observations and available Sun observations.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: No camera images, gyro noise or estimator fusion is modeled.
Remaining FREYA verification: Validate MEMS/camera/Sun fusion and orbital limb/feature observations with representative imagery.

Requirement text: The vehicle shall inhibit deorbit firing unless attitude, estimated orbit state, predicted entry corridor and propulsion readiness satisfy approved limits.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: A target-search output is not an ignition permissive or fault model.
Remaining FREYA verification: Define confidence thresholds, readiness logic and independent inhibits; test out-of-limit cases.

Requirement text: The deorbit propulsion system shall provide the trajectory-specific required impulse and delta-v with defined dispersions and margin.  (Proposed assumption; verify by analysis and test) Planning baseline: For the assumed 300 km orbit and 50 km vacuum-periapsis proxy, use 60.3 m/s ideal delta-v, with 25% planning margin (75.4 m/s). At 50 kg B wet mass, the impulse-equivalent planning value is 3.77 kN s; actual delivered impulse must be calculated with rocket equation and a motor thrust curve.
Simulation scope: A nominal burn meets vacuum demand but fails the 25% planning allowance. B is sized only for nominal demand.
Remaining FREYA verification: A motor margin must be resolved; B reserve capacity, motor curve, pointing and dispersions remain unverified.

Requirement text: The sacrificial DOM shall mount beneath the heat shield without compromising the thermal-protection barrier.  (Established)
Simulation scope: External DOM mounting is drawn only.
Remaining FREYA verification: Demonstrate load transfer, fasteners and an uninterrupted TPS barrier.

Requirement text: The hybrid-engine trade shall evaluate paraffin fuel, N2O oxidizer, tankage, feed system and ignition against the A solid-motor architecture.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: B nominal thrust and fuel/oxidizer masses are calculated for assumed Isp and O/F.
Remaining FREYA verification: Paraffin/N2O regression, tank/feed/ignition design and signed solid-versus-hybrid hardware trade are absent.

Requirement text: If selected, the cold-gas attitude system shall include all thrusters, valves, plumbing, regulator and usable N2O/N2 gas mass in the budget.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: N2 maneuver consumption and ideal storage residual are calculated.
Remaining FREYA verification: Valve/regulator/plumbing/thruster masses, N2O phase behavior, compatibility and complete allocated mass remain unverified.

Requirement text: Attitude control shall account for momentum buildup, wheel saturation, deorbit disturbances and the absence or availability of desaturation actuators.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: No wheel momentum accumulation, saturation or disturbance integration.
Remaining FREYA verification: Size desaturation actuators and demonstrate momentum management for selected attitude architecture.

Requirement text: Orbit and attitude estimation shall demonstrate observability during camera occultation, low-light conditions and changing Mars viewing geometry.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: No navigation covariance or visibility outage model.
Remaining FREYA verification: Camera occultation/low light and changing viewing geometry require observability analysis and HIL tests.

Requirement text: The reference entry trajectory shall originate from approximately 300 km Mars orbit; actual entry interface and flight-path angle shall be determined by trajectory design.  (Established / derived)
Simulation scope: Both baseline cases start at 300 km and calculate a descending 125 km interface state and flight-path angle.
Remaining FREYA verification: Numerical reference-trajectory evidence only; corridor validation, navigation errors and orbit dispersions remain open.

Requirement text: The aeroshell shall maintain a thermally and dynamically acceptable entry attitude throughout peak heating and deceleration.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Heat-shield-forward attitude is imposed, not a simulated stability result.
Remaining FREYA verification: 6-DOF aero-moments, CG/CP, attitude dispersions and thermal attitude limits must be demonstrated.

Requirement text: TPS sizing shall use trajectory-dependent convective and radiative heating, heat soak, ablation and aluminum-shell temperature limits.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Trajectory-dependent convective heating, radiation loss and two-node heat soak are computed.
Remaining FREYA verification: Incident gas radiation, ablation, pyrolysis and aluminum-shell temperatures/limits are not modeled.

Requirement text: Parachute deployment shall occur only within verified Mach number, dynamic pressure and altitude envelopes.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Deployment is scheduled by altitude and timing, without validated Mach/q gates.
Remaining FREYA verification: Select and test Mach/dynamic-pressure/altitude envelopes and enforce flight inhibits.

Requirement text: The PCM recovery parachute shall have nominal 1.5 m diameter, pending Mars deployment and descent qualification.  (Established / verify)
Simulation scope: A retained-carrier descent uses the 1.5 m canopy and reaches ground.
Remaining FREYA verification: Canopy scaling, supersonic deployment, strength, opening load and stability remain unqualified.

Requirement text: The PCM recovery parachute shall use the 2.0 m candidate diameter pending vehicle-level mass and deployment analysis.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: B retained-carrier descent uses the 2.0 m candidate canopy and reaches ground.
Remaining FREYA verification: Vehicle-level canopy and deployment-load qualification are absent.

Requirement text: The system shall safely separate the heat shield and upper cover in the commanded sequence without collision with the PCM or probes.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Sequence ordering/graphics do not propagate separation bodies.
Remaining FREYA verification: Collision-free shield/cover/PCM separation needs multibody dynamics and representative tests.

Requirement text: The descent system shall determine probe release altitude using a qualified sensing and estimation method with defined uncertainty.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Solver altitude is exact model truth, not a noisy sensor estimate.
Remaining FREYA verification: Select radar/lidar/barometric sensing and qualify release-altitude uncertainty.

Requirement text: Each probe shall deploy a nominal 0.5 m parachute, subject to terminal-speed and stability verification.  (Established / verify)
Simulation scope: Individual 0.5 m canopy drag/inflation proxies produce finite probe descent trajectories.
Remaining FREYA verification: Probe attitude stability, real inflation and Mars deployment acceptance remain open.

Requirement text: The EDL analysis shall account for the low density and variability of the Martian atmosphere, winds, and landing-site elevation.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Density scale height and optional horizontal wind change the nominal descent.
Remaining FREYA verification: No atmospheric ensemble, terrain/elevation map or site-dependent density/wind dispersions.

Requirement text: The PCM shall restrain three probes in vertical stowage until commanded release.  (Established)
Simulation scope: Three probes are instantiated; restraint forces/stowage tolerances are not modeled.
Remaining FREYA verification: Actual vertical restraint/release hardware and launch-load testing are required.

Requirement text: Each PCM shall restrain seven probes in vertical stowage until commanded release.  (Established probe count; assumed packaging envelope) Planning baseline: Assume seven vertically stowed probes in a 3+3+1 arrangement. Verify fit inside the 800 mm diameter shell with a CAD swept-volume extraction study and positive clearance at maximum tolerance.
Simulation scope: Seven probe records do not prove 3+3+1 packaging.
Remaining FREYA verification: Verify CAD swept volume inside the 800 mm shell at worst tolerances and loaded extraction.

Requirement text: The PCM shall release probes individually, without mechanical interference, following an altitude-gated release schedule.  (Established / derived)
Simulation scope: Release altitude, individual sequencing, inherited state and carrier mass shedding are checked.
Remaining FREYA verification: Mechanical interference and actuator release reliability require multibody/test evidence.

Requirement text: The PCM shall remain retained through entry until its extraction conditions are met.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Carrier retention until an assumed gate is an imposed model boundary.
Remaining FREYA verification: Demonstrate restraint survival and qualified extraction conditions on hardware.

Requirement text: The carrier ejection system shall demonstrate cover clearance, parachute extraction and no contact with critical spacecraft elements.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Carrier extraction is schematic; no body-clearance dynamics.
Remaining FREYA verification: FREYA ejection geometry, canopy extraction and no-contact tests are required.

Requirement text: Any pyrotechnic separation device shall have independent electrical inhibits and ground-safe handling provisions.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: No electrical inhibit or pyro circuit is modeled.
Remaining FREYA verification: Independent inhibits, ground-safe handling and safety review are required.

Requirement text: Release sequencing shall provide an adjustable interval and shall be validated against descent rate, wind drift and probe separation.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Adjustable release cadence and a wind sensitivity case propagate separate probe trajectories.
Remaining FREYA verification: No full dispersion/collision analysis or hardware cadence acceptance limits.

Requirement text: Each probe shall have a nominal overall length of 200 mm and main-body diameter of 50 mm.  (Established)
Simulation scope: 50 mm diameter and 200 mm length are inputs to impact screening.
Remaining FREYA verification: Manufactured body dimensions and packaged internals require inspection; assumed values are not evidence.

Requirement text: Each probe shall include an upper shoulder of nominal 75 mm diameter over approximately the upper third of its length.  (Established)
Simulation scope: 75 mm shoulder geometry is not propagated as an impact contact model.
Remaining FREYA verification: Verify shoulder dimensions, length fraction, antenna/chute interface and its penetration effect.

Requirement text: Each probe flight mass shall be 2.00 kg including science payload, power, structure, radio, parachute and consumables.  (Established)
Simulation scope: 2 kg is an assumed complete mass used by equations.
Remaining FREYA verification: Weighed payload/structure/chute/consumables bill of materials and component boundary closure are absent.

Requirement text: Each probe shall retain a pointed lower penetration head and deploy in an attitude that supports near-vertical surface penetration.  (Established / derived)
Simulation scope: Analytical impact calculations accept an assumed nose-first/obliquity input.
Remaining FREYA verification: Nose-first stability is not predicted; Deep Space 2 is not successful penetrator heritage. Validate shape and deployment attitude.

Requirement text: Each probe shall provide a tether-integrated antenna connection from the center of its upper end.  (Established)
Simulation scope: No tether/antenna mechanical or RF model.
Remaining FREYA verification: Demonstrate tether retention, feed, deployment, burial performance and RF link on representative hardware.

Requirement text: The probe shall protect the science sample and sample pathway from contamination introduced by spacecraft materials or entry heating.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: No sample-path contamination or internal probe thermal model.
Remaining FREYA verification: Contamination budgets and sampled-material temperature/integrity need analysis and tests.

Requirement text: The science system shall execute a documented life-detection measurement protocol with controls, blanks and decision thresholds.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Science animation is illustrative; no detector counts, controls data or decision threshold analysis.
Remaining FREYA verification: FREYA-specific assay, blanks, sensitivity and false-positive limits require laboratory validation; Viking methods differ.

Requirement text: The science system shall obtain, transfer and analyze Martian material with demonstrated sample mass, depth, integrity and instrument sensitivity.  (Proposed assumption; verify by analysis and test) Planning baseline: Assume a 0.5 g minimum collected sample from 20-100 mm below the local surface per probe, with 80% transfer efficiency and duplicate blank/control measurements. These are science-planning targets requiring laboratory validation.
Simulation scope: No sample acquisition/transfer mass, efficiency or sensitivity simulation.
Remaining FREYA verification: Demonstrate 0.5 g collection, 20–100 mm provenance, 80% transfer and control handling; impact depth is not sample acquisition.

Requirement text: The probe shall provide energy storage and environmental protection sufficient for the approved post-landing operating duration.  (Proposed assumption; verify by analysis and test) Planning baseline: Assume 24 h A and 72 h B surface operation, with a 20% usable energy margin after temperature derating and communications duty cycle.
Simulation scope: Assumed usable energy minus average load leaves at least 20% reserve in A and B screens.
Remaining FREYA verification: Probe temperature derating, power duty-cycle model, heaters and actual batteries are unqualified.

Requirement text: The science and communications system shall operate under defined dust deposition, temperature and illumination cases.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: No dust/illumination/temperature operating-cases model.
Remaining FREYA verification: Define FREYA operating envelope and demonstrate science/RF performance under those cases.

Requirement text: The probe shall demonstrate survival of the predicted impact loads across the defined regolith and ice mechanical-property envelope.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Impact g/depth is an uncalibrated point-mass screen, not survival evidence.
Remaining FREYA verification: Representative regolith/ice impacts and instrument shock/survival tests are required.

Requirement text: The mission shall define an end-to-end telecommunications path, link budget, data storage and expected data return to Earth.  (Proposed assumption; verify by analysis and test) Planning baseline: Assume a Mars-orbit relay link using a UHF compatible transceiver, onboard buffering of at least 64 MB A / 256 MB B per probe, and at least 95% data retention until relay opportunity; final interoperability depends on relay provider agreement.
Simulation scope: Free-space link margin is positive for assumed receiver/range; buffers are configuration values.
Remaining FREYA verification: No 95% retention, contact schedule, end-to-end storage model or provider agreement.

Requirement text: Each probe shall provide unique identification, health telemetry and time-tagged science data.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Each virtual probe has an ID and timestamped release/trajectory rows; synthetic carrier status is encoded.
Remaining FREYA verification: No actual time-tagged science packets, synchronization, flight transceiver or end-to-end verification.

Requirement text: The program shall determine applicable Mars planetary-protection classification with the responsible authority before flight hardware processing.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Mission classification is not established by simulation or another mission.
Remaining FREYA verification: Responsible authority must determine FREYA classification before processing; heritage cannot grant approval.

Requirement text: Life-detection sample-contacting hardware shall meet the approved biological contamination and recontamination prevention requirements.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: No biological cleanliness or recontamination simulation.
Remaining FREYA verification: FREYA sample-contact hardware must meet its approved bioburden and recontamination criteria.

Requirement text: The program shall maintain bidirectional traceability from mission objectives through requirements, design, test evidence and anomalies.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: 91 unique source identifiers are preserved and linked to this evidence register.
Remaining FREYA verification: Full bidirectional objectives/design/tests/anomalies traceability and ownership remain incomplete.

Requirement text: Each flight-critical release, ignition, attitude and descent function shall be verified by analysis and representative integrated testing.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: Preliminary analytical checks exercise nominal flight functions.
Remaining FREYA verification: Representative integrated hardware testing, flight-code verification and qualification remain absent.

Requirement text: The program shall perform thermal-vacuum, vibration, shock, deployment and impact qualification at documented environments.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: No environmental hardware-test results are supplied.
Remaining FREYA verification: Thermal-vacuum, vibration, shock, deployment and impact acceptance records are required.

Requirement text: The program shall approve a fault tree and hazard controls for propulsion, pressure vessels, pyrotechnics and inadvertent Mars impact.  (Proposed)
Simulation scope: No approved fault tree or hazard-control verification.
Remaining FREYA verification: Approval and implementation evidence for propulsion/pressure/pyro/Mars-impact hazards remain required.

Requirement text: Provide calibrated camera measurements of the Mars limb/horizon, apparent disk size and identifiable large-scale surface features when visible; estimate attitude and orbital/ground-track state with uncertainty.
Simulation scope: Camera/Mars limb images are not processed; ground target uses supplied orbit truth.
Remaining FREYA verification: Calibrated orbital image sequences, estimator uncertainty and navigation error budget remain open.

Requirement text: Observe the Sun when within the camera field of view and safe sensor exposure limits; fuse Sun-direction observations with Mars observations and inertial data.
Simulation scope: No Sun sensor/camera exposure or observation fusion model.
Remaining FREYA verification: Different hardware Sun-sensing heritage does not validate FREYA safe camera exposure, fusion or visibility.

Requirement text: Use a MEMS gyroscope/IMU to propagate attitude between optical observations; estimate gyro bias and bound drift when Mars and Sun are temporarily unavailable.
Simulation scope: No MEMS gyro bias, thermal drift or propagation between observations.
Remaining FREYA verification: Test actual sensor calibration and bounded estimator drift during observation outages.

Requirement text: Run deterministic guidance, navigation and control on a Raspberry Pi-class processor, with ML-assisted Mars limb / landmark detection; safety-critical control shall not rely solely on unverified ML output.
Simulation scope: Browser calculation does not execute or benchmark flight GNC/ML on a Pi-class target.
Remaining FREYA verification: Selected processor, WCET, ML errors, deterministic partitioning and independent inhibits need qualification.

Requirement text: Control spacecraft attitude using six independently commanded cold-gas thrusters, with verified torque authority about three axes and fault-tolerant command inhibits.
Simulation scope: Balanced-pair scalar torque and gas consumption are checked.
Remaining FREYA verification: Six-jet three-axis control matrix, minimum impulse bit, failed jets and closed-loop control are not modeled.

Requirement text: Verify attitude and orbital-state confidence before deorbit ignition; inhibit ignition if navigation confidence, pointing error or thruster health is outside approved limits.
Simulation scope: A successful nominal target search has no navigation-confidence threshold or fault response.
Remaining FREYA verification: Monte Carlo, sensor-health inputs and safe/inhibit logic must be implemented and tested.

Requirement text: Define six-thruster implementation as a proposed architecture change. Reconcile against the existing four-reaction-wheel baseline and Configuration B hybrid oxidizer / cold-gas supply; do not assume N2O thrusters share a tank without regulator, phase-state and compatibility qualification.
Simulation scope: Architecture conflicts are recorded, not resolved by a signed trade.
Remaining FREYA verification: Approve wheel-versus-six-jet architecture, P&ID, mass/power/ICD and N2O/N2 compatibility decisions.

Requirement text: Establish the entry corridor, worst-case heating rate, integrated heat load, dynamic pressure, deceleration, aero-moments and center-of-pressure movement for dispersions in Mars atmosphere and vehicle properties.
Simulation scope: Nominal heating/dynamic-pressure/deceleration histories are available.
Remaining FREYA verification: Worst-case corridor/dispersion analysis, aero-moments and CG/CP movement are not calculated.

Requirement text: Size and qualify the ablative heat shield, insulation and aluminum backshell for peak and integrated heat exposure; maintain internal electronics, batteries, PCM and probe temperatures within qualified limits.
Simulation scope: Generic surface and backing-node temperatures support preliminary thermal review.
Remaining FREYA verification: Ablative material response and internal electronics/battery/PCM/probe limits are not verified.

Requirement text: Maintain positive structural margins for peak aerodynamic pressure, deceleration, vibration, thermal gradients, fastener and joint loads, including the 70 mm heat-shield-to-backshell transition.
Simulation scope: Nominal entry loads provide a possible future structural input.
Remaining FREYA verification: No coupled FEA, joints, thermal stress or 70 mm transition structural margins.

Requirement text: Ensure the external deorbit/hybrid propulsion module does not penetrate the heat shield and that sacrificial attachments cannot cause unacceptable TPS damage, destabilization or debris impact during entry.
Simulation scope: Expendable module is depicted, not tested for TPS damage or debris interaction.
Remaining FREYA verification: Drawings, separation dynamics, debris analysis and TPS continuity acceptance remain required.

Requirement text: Demonstrate stable heat-shield-forward entry and adequate control authority before atmospheric interface; prohibit reliance on active cold-gas control after its external hardware is sacrificed.
Simulation scope: Shield-forward view and zero lift are assumptions; no 6-DOF stability/control-transition simulation.
Remaining FREYA verification: Validate passive stable attitude and pre-entry authority; no cold-gas credit after module loss.

Requirement text: Verify cover release, parachute deployment and PCM ejection only after thermal, dynamic-pressure and deceleration conditions are inside qualified release envelopes.
Simulation scope: Scripted cover/chute/PCM order does not enforce qualified thermal/Mach/q conditions.
Remaining FREYA verification: Verified event gates, dispersion analysis and integrated separation/deployment tests are absent.

Requirement text: Integrate a low-average-duty-cycle, high-peak-power radio transmitter and energy buffer within the probe carrier, with a defined antenna, receiver/relay target and link budget.
Simulation scope: Assumed high-peak/low-duty RF link and average DC energy screens are positive.
Remaining FREYA verification: Actual carrier transmitter, pulse buffer, antenna pointing and accepted relay path are not integrated.

Requirement text: Transmit the nine-bit cumulative mission-status payload nominally once per 60 seconds; queue events between transmissions and repeat the latest status until carrier power is exhausted or mission complete.
Simulation scope: 9-bit A and 13-bit B cumulative payload encoding is checked.
Remaining FREYA verification: 60 s review-time attempts are synthetic; no flight timer, reset/outage queue or actual RF transmission test.

Requirement text: Provide independent energy storage sized for transmitter peak power without browning out avionics or release actuators; limit average consumption by duty cycling.
Simulation scope: Duty-cycle/average-energy arithmetic is available.
Remaining FREYA verification: No buffer voltage/ESR, peak-current, brownout, battery thermal or independent carrier energy-store tests.

Requirement text: Record event time and confidence locally, protect the latched status word against resets, and distinguish command issuance from sensor-confirmed completion.
Simulation scope: Browser event chronology and cumulative bit latching are reproducible.
Remaining FREYA verification: Sensor confidence, command-versus-confirmation hardware inputs and nonvolatile reset recovery are absent.

Requirement text: Do not credit reception during entry plasma blackout, antenna occlusion or carrier tumbling without validated link analysis; store and retransmit status when a link becomes available.
Simulation scope: No plasma blackout, tumble/occlusion or outage/retransmission model.
Remaining FREYA verification: Validate FREYA link availability and buffered repeat transmissions over missed passes.

Requirement text: The program shall produce a 6-DOF Mars orbit-to-surface trajectory Monte Carlo, including atmospheric dispersions, prior to propulsion selection. Verification: Analysis.
Simulation scope: Current solver is deterministic and reduced-order, not 6-DOF Monte Carlo.
Remaining FREYA verification: Produce a validated orbit-to-surface 6-DOF atmospheric-dispersion ensemble before propulsion selection.

Requirement text: The propulsion design shall demonstrate delivered delta-v and pointing error with a 20 kg initial mass and explicit propulsion margin. Verification: Analysis + test.
Simulation scope: A achieves about 64.99 m/s versus 75.34 m/s planning demand.
Remaining FREYA verification: Resolve delivered impulse margin and demonstrate pointing error and flight motor performance.

Requirement text: The aeroshell shall have a validated coupled aerothermal and structural model including 600 mm upper shell, aluminum thermal limits, and 70 mm transition. Verification: Analysis + test.
Simulation scope: Generic two-node TPS estimate is not coupled aerothermal/structural validation.
Remaining FREYA verification: Include actual aluminum shell, 600 mm height, 70 mm transition and validated material/load response.

Requirement text: The descent system shall meet qualified deployment Mach, dynamic-pressure, altitude and inflation-load limits; nominal chute diameters alone are not acceptance criteria. Verification: Analysis + test.
Simulation scope: Altitude-only timing and nominal canopy diameters do not prove qualified deployment.
Remaining FREYA verification: Meet validated Mach, q, altitude and inflation-load limits for FREYA hardware.

Requirement text: Each probe shall meet defined impact speed, attitude, penetration-depth and survival envelopes over specified soil/ice conditions. Verification: Test.
Simulation scope: Nominal impact speeds and preliminary g/depth sensitivity are calculated.
Remaining FREYA verification: No measured soil/ice calibration, attitude distribution, penetration acceptance or instrument survival.

Requirement text: The navigation system shall quantify covariance and observability across periods without camera or Sun visibility. Verification: Simulation + test.
Simulation scope: No estimator covariance or orbital observation-outage simulation.
Remaining FREYA verification: Navigation uncertainty/observability must be measured and simulated for FREYA sensors and geometry.

Requirement text: Each life-detection measurement shall have documented blanks, contamination budgets, calibration, detection limits and false-positive controls. Verification: Test + review.
Simulation scope: No laboratory blanks, detection limits or false-positive data in the simulator.
Remaining FREYA verification: Validate FREYA assay controls/calibration/contamination budgets; flown Viking controls are only analogous.

Requirement text: The spacecraft shall demonstrate positive power and communication margins for the selected operating duration and geometry. Verification: Analysis + test.
Simulation scope: Assumed source-default RF margin and surface energy reserve are positive.
Remaining FREYA verification: Actual flight batteries, temperatures, burst loads and provider geometry require end-to-end test.

Requirement text: The program shall approve an end-to-end planetary protection implementation plan before hardware exposure to flight environments. Verification: Review.
Simulation scope: No approved FREYA planetary-protection implementation plan is provided.
Remaining FREYA verification: Authority approval and end-to-end handling/bioburden/recontamination implementation remain open.

Requirement text: A complete requirement verification matrix shall define objective pass/fail criteria, owners and evidence for every MIS/STR/GNC/EDL/PCM/PRB/SYS/DER item. Verification: Inspection.
Simulation scope: This register covers all 91 identifiers with evidence and gaps.
Remaining FREYA verification: This is an evidence assessment, not an approved verification matrix; named owners and objective acceptance limits still need approval.
